description.narrative: Cyclone Mocha (pronounced “Mokha”) formed in the southern Bay of Bengal on 11 May and started to move north-east toward western Myanmar. It is likely to continue intensifying as it moves north-eastwards on 12 and 13 May and is predicted to make landfall around noon on 14 May in the Rakhine State (west Myanmar) as a very severe cyclonic storm with maximum sustained wind speeds of up to 165 km/h. From 12-14 May southeast Bangladesh and northern Myanmar can expect heavy rainfall and strong winds. Storm surges with heights of about 2.0-2.5m are also predicted, which could inundate the low lying areas of north Myanmar and adjoining southeast Bangladesh coasts during the time of landfall.
